content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures asphalt plants and crushers for road and quarry customers, not rented power or proppant logistics."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Natural gas producer and gathering operator selling gas and power, not renting mobile generation to customers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures and services microturbines sold to users, rather than renting and operating its own mobile power fleet."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Contracted construction and maintenance work on utility and telecom networks, not equipment rental or sand logistics."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Regulated utility distributing gas and power to homes and businesses, with a different customer base and model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Rents downhole drilling tools to drillers; a rental model in oilfields, but different equipment and no power or sand."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Provides artificial lift and production equipment for producing wells, not mobile power or proppant handling."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Midstream gathering, processing and pipeline operator fees, not rented equipment or on-site power and sand logistics."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Contractor building telecom, utility and pipeline networks under construction contracts, not equipment rental operations."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Rents gas-fired compression equipment from its fleet to the same producers, operated on-site under contract, like Solaris's rental power model."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Provides proppant logistics, transloading and terminal storage to oilfield customers, overlapping Solaris's sand logistics, though it also mines sand."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Retail propane and heating oil distributor serving households and businesses, unrelated to oilfield power or sand logistics."}]}
